$comment: Read by scripts/i18n-check.mjs and by the translation worker. signatures: exact strings that must stay identical in every locale wherever the source (it) message contains them. keep: product and brand terms that stay untranslated. tone: house voice per locale.

tone.it: Diretto, concreto, dà del tu. Frasi brevi, niente gergo e niente promesse vaghe.
tone.en: Plain, direct, second person. Short sentences, no buzzwords, no vague promises. Do not sound like a translation from Italian.

rules: Placeholders such as {year} or {amount} stay identical in every locale.
Arrows and symbols (↗ → ©) stay where the source puts them.
Prices and currency come from the pricing engine, never from a translation.
Length: a translation should stay within 0.4x to 2.5x of the source length for short strings.
